title: Senior Oracle Apps Database Administrator
description:
**Description**

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.

**Summary:**

We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented **Oracle Apps DBA** to join our Enterprise Database Infrastructure team. This position is a unique opportunity for a mid-level professional looking to work on product based organization as an Application and database administration.

The successful candidate will work directly under the guidance of our Senior Oracle Applications Architects and DBAs to support our critical enterprise Applications and database environments.

**Mandatory Requirements**
--------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related technical discipline.
* **Availability:** Ability to work in Shifts with occasional flexibility for planned system maintenance windows.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Learning & Development:** Participate actively in structured technical training covering Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), database architectures, and auxiliary systems.
* **Monitoring & Health Checks:** Assist in daily system monitoring, verifying database integrity, reviewing error logs, and ensuring routine backup jobs complete successfully.
* **Access Control & Auditing:** Help manage user access provisions, role assignments, and password policies in strict accordance with corporate security standards.
* **Documentation & Compliance:** Assist in maintaining operational run books and compiling system logs/evidence for quarterly SOX compliance audits.
* **Troubleshooting:** Identify, document, and escalate database performance or connectivity issues under the supervision of senior team members.

**Position Duties and Responsibilities:**

* 4 to 6 years of experience in Oracle Apps Database Administration (11i and R12 applications with Database 11g & 12c).
* Strong working experience in monitoring, performance tuning, and production support for high-transaction, large-scale RDBMS Oracle databases.
* Expertise across major technology stack components, including Database, iAS, Forms, Reports, PL/SQL, Java, Enterprise Manager, SOA, WebLogic, and JVM.
* Hands-on experience with ADPatch, AutoConfig, and other AD utilities.
* Proven track record in database installations, upgrades, and DB migrations.
* Direct experience with ASM, Data Guard, Disaster Recovery solutions, and database backup strategies.
* Ability to develop Shell scripts for UNIX administrative tasks, database task scheduling, and monitoring.
* Knowledge of Linux commands for managing database and application services.
* Experience maintaining technical documentation (e.g., inventory, installation procedures).
* Familiarity with RAC is an advantage.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and work on Cloud Platforms.
* Readiness to work in shifts and provide weekend on-call support.
* Strong communication skills for effective stakeholder interaction.

title: Admin & Event Coordinator
description:
**Position Title:** Admin & Event Coordinator

**Location:** Madipakkam

**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Working days:** Monday - Saturday

**Working Timings:** 9.00AM- 6.00PM

**Experience:** 1–2 Years

**Required Qualification:** Master of Social Work (MSW)

About the Role

We are seeking an energetic, empathetic, and organized **Admin & Event Coordinator** to join our Chess Academy. This role uniquely blends core administrative responsibilities with community and school outreach.

Leveraging an MSW background, the ideal candidate will effectively build relationships with school administrators, parents, and students while organizing chess events, workshops, and inter-school tournaments.

Key Responsibilities1. Academy Administration & Operations

* Manage daily office and front-desk operations at the Chess Academy.
* Handle inquiries (walk-in, phone, email) from prospective students and parents.
* Manage student enrollments, fee collection, attendance records, and database management.
* Coordinate coach schedules, training sessions, and classroom setups.
* Maintain inventory for chess sets, clock timers, learning materials, and office supplies.

2. School Outreach & Event Planning

* Serve as the primary liaison between the Chess Academy and partner/prospective schools.
* Plan, schedule, and execute chess workshops, awareness sessions, and inter-school tournaments.
* Visit schools regularly to oversee chess program implementation, build relationships with school authorities, and gather feedback.
* Manage event logistics end-to-end: venue booking, equipment distribution, certificates, trophies, sound/media, and refreshments.
* Coordinate student registration, referee schedules, and parent communication for all internal and external events.

3. Student & Parent Engagement (MSW Focus)

* Apply social work principles to foster a safe, positive, and inclusive learning environment for young players.
* Communicate effectively with parents regarding student progress, behavioral feedback, and tournament guidance.
* Handle grievances or concerns professionally and empathetically.

Qualifications & Skills

* **Education:** Master of Social Work (MSW) or equivalent degree in Social Sciences/Humanities.
* **Experience:** 1–2 years of experience in administration, event coordination, or community outreach (experience in educational institutes or academies is a plus).
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and local languages.
* **Interpersonal Skills:** Strong ability to connect with children, parents, school principals, and staff.
* **Organizational Skills:** Exceptional multitasking, event management, and time-management abilities.
* **Tech Savvy:** Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and basic digital management tools.
* **Mobility:** Willingness to travel locally to schools and event locations as needed.

Preferred Attributes

* Basic interest in or knowledge of Chess (not mandatory, but advantageous).
* Strong problem-solving mindset and adaptability in high-energy environments.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Java DBA Engineer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**

As the world’s most global bank, Citi gives you the tools to be a trailblazer. We’re not just building technology; we’re building the future of banking. With thousands of employees located around the globe, we are an international team encompassing a broad range of teams, roles, and cultures, and we invite you to come and join us!

Citi’s technology team supports business operations in 100+ countries, across multiple lines of business spanning both Institutional and retail businesses.

The group works to optimize the IT environment by standardizing production platforms, reducing complexity, and introducing innovative solutions that provide new business capabilities, reduce total cost of ownership, and create a competitive advantage for Citi.

We want to regularly engage with talented individuals who are passionate about producing clean, testable code as part of a high performing team. We have found this to be way more important than experience in the financial sector.

We welcome applications from any industry and should you wish to apply your application will be reviewed for a multitude of Developer positions at varying levels.

**What We do / The Team**

* Citi FX has a physical presence in 83 countries with 1,400 dedicated staff giving us the largest FX presence of any bank globally. Foreign Exchange has been one of the defining businesses of Citi for much of its 200 year existence.
* Citi has the largest FX presence of any bank globally and we proudly put this down to delivering unrivalled service and insight to our clients. Increasing investment in technology has seen us roll out award winning applications. Technology is a central pillar for our plans to sustain and grow our FX business.
* Above all, we seek individuals who seek exceptional attitude and aptitude in the people they work with and have a demonstrated passion for delivering FX technology in support of our #1 FX business.

**Role Overview/What will you do:**

* As a Senior Java Engineer, your mission is to help shape our team of innovators and technologists toward creating next-level solutions that improve the way our business is run.
* Hands on technical implementation of Prime Brokerage solutions across FX and Equities using modern, cloud-native technologies and CI/CD workflows, focusing on consolidation, automation, and scalability.
* Drive the design and development of system architecture, work with end-users of the systems, and enhance the quality of deliverables Ensure staff follows Citi documented policy and procedures as well as maintain desktop procedures and supporting documentation for filings on a current basis and in comprehensive manner
* The successful candidate will work with teams across FX Technology implement solutions that benefit the business
* Collaborate with stakeholders across FX Prime Brokerage trading , Quants and Product team to understand Payments needs, translate them into impactful data-driven solutions, and deliver these in partnership with technology.
* Design, Development, Testing of new features in the applications.
* Continual improvement of the software development lifecycle and quality of the product.
* 3rd line support of the production system (dedicated 24h support teams handle 1st / 2nd line).
* Mentoring junior members of the team.
* Contribute to defining and implementing best practices and processes for the department and ensure transparency and consistency across teams

**Key Skills and Experience required –**

* Master’s degree or above (or equivalent education) in a STEM discipline.
* Proven experience in software engineering and development, and a strong understanding of computer systems and how they operate.
* Hands on Experience in Java , Spring, Understanding of ultra-low-latency development practices.
* Proven understanding of FX highly preferred
* Well versed with AI coding tools like Devin , Claude code and Codex and delivered production grade applications.
* Proven track record of building new systems, replacing legacy systems and renovating existing systems
* Strong skill set in SQL / Databases
* Strong understanding of Messaging tech like Kafka, Solace , MQ etc.
* Writing production scale applications to use the Caching technologies.
* The candidate will have systems (software, hardware, networks) knowledge required to define solutions and trouble shoot issues
* Exceptional communicator who loves working with people, confident communicating at all levels from an individual team to the entire enterprise
* Highly credible hands on engineer, confident to deep dive into a product and codebase and offer detailed, constructive analysis and feedback
* Awareness of industry trends and leveraging new technologies as appropriate

**Any Beneficial / Nice to have skills and experience:**

* Understanding of Openshift , Kubernetes
* KDB knowledge

title: Mainframe DB2 CDC Database Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

In this role, you will play a key part in administering and supporting Mainframe DB2 and CDC environments, managing database operations, configuring and maintaining CDC replication solutions, ensuring data integrity, optimizing system performance, troubleshooting replication issues, and supporting high-availability data replication across enterprise platforms.
  
  
**What you will Do**

  

* Administer and support IBM Db2 for z/OS databases in a large-scale mainframe environment.
* Configure, monitor, and maintain CDC (Change Data Capture) replication solutions to enable real-time data movement across platforms.
* Ensure data integrity, consistency, and availability throughout replication and database operations.
* Monitor and optimize Db2 and CDC performance, identifying and resolving system bottlenecks and replication latency issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve database, replication, and connectivity incidents to meet service level objectives.
* Perform database maintenance activities, including backup, recovery, migration, upgrades, and patch management.
Support high availability and disaster recovery strategies for mission-critical Db2 environments.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 8+ years of experience in administering and supporting Mainframe z/OS, IBM DB2, and IMS databases, including database structure administration, utility management, performance optimization, and database maintenance activities across enterprise environments.
* Analyze and troubleshoot IMS and DB2 batch job failures, ensuring timely resolution and root cause identification.
* Perform DB2 and IMS structure backfill, database refreshes, and recovery activities across non-production and production environments.
* Execute tablespace and index reorganizations, space reclamation, performance tuning, and capacity management initiatives.
* Review and optimize SQL queries and access paths, improving database performance and reducing resource consumption.
* Create and manage change tickets, supporting end-to-end implementation from development through production deployment.
* Monitor DB2/IMS health check jobs, tablespace status, database objects, and perform object alterations using DB2 commands as required.
Support IMS administration activities including DBD changes, ACBGEN, DELGEN, AUTOGEN, DBRC registration, backup/recovery, reporting, documentation, and knowledge transfer initiatives.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* 3+ years of experience in MF DB2 CDC Database Administration with expertise in IBM IIDR/Change Data Capture (CDC), replication monitoring, subscription management, and troubleshooting replication issues.
* Hands-on experience in monitoring and maintaining CDA subscriptions, performing subscription refreshes, schema modifications, and ensuring seamless data synchronization between source and target databases.
* Proficient in creating replication SQLs for DB2 tables, managing TOAD Oracle environments, and developing IMS structural queries for Kafka-based data replication.
* Strong Enterprise Linux administration skills with proven ability to create and maintain technical documentation for installations, upgrades, operational procedures, and support processes.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to logically diagnose and resolve complex replication and database-related issues.  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Spec-Prog & Proj Mgmt
description:
### **When you join Verizon**


You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and experienced Senior SAM Flexera Specialist with a strong track record in end\-to\-end Publisher Management. You will be responsible for executing the daily lifecycle management software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive initial publisher onboarding, translate software contracts, continuously manage deployment data to maintain accurate Effective License Positions (ELPs), and identify continuous cost optimization opportunities across the software estate.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Executing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of software publishers within Flexera, from hands\-on initial onboarding through ongoing compliance monitoring.
* Interpreting EULAs, Master Services Agreements (MSAs), and purchase histories to accurately build and maintain license records and product use rights (PUR) in Flexera.
* Producing and updating defensible, audit\-ready ELP reports for managed publishers by reconciling entitlements against actual software installations and usage.
* Actively identifying software optimization opportunities by flagging shelfware, over\-licensed applications, and unmanaged installations to drive continuous cost savings.
* Normalizing raw inventory, application catalog items, and software signatures utilizing Technopedia and Flexera's recognition engines.
* Monitoring Flexera Beacon servers, inventory agent deployments, inventory alerts, and data processing jobs to ensure daily platform health.
* Supporting ecosystem integrations between Flexera and external tools, including ServiceNow CMDB, SaaS APIs, and secondary discovery sources .
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.

### **What we’re looking for...**


You are a highly analytical thinker with a deep, hands\-on understanding of software asset management tools and publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent technical and problem\-solving skills, coupled with a proactive approach to maintaining data accuracy and uncovering cost savings. You thrive in a highly integrated data environment and are passionate about operational excellence.


You'll need to have:

* 5 to 7 years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 3\+ years of dedicated hands\-on experience using Flexera.
* Proven track record in executing end\-to\-end publisher management, successfully onboarding and continuously managing software publishers within Flexera.
* Strong understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Adobe, VMware/Broadcom, Red Hat).
* Solid operational knowledge of ecosystem integrations, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, and discovery agent data flows.
* Advanced data analysis skills utilizing Excel and relational database logic to manage and synthesize complex software entitlement data sets.


Even better if you have one or more of the following:

* Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software.
* Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate repetitive data management tasks.


If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **Where you’ll be working**


In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.
